Giants vs Rams DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, September 21 · NFL Week 2 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 20, 10:09 AM ET

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Monday Night Football's Giants at Rams DraftKings Showdown slate: 19.3 DraftKings points at an $11,400 FLEX salary, or 28.9 at captain for $17,100. Jaxson Dart holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 79% across 10,000 simulations, and Jaxson Dart holds the largest captain share at 21.0%.

Behind Nacua, the next four projections are Jaxson Dart (17.9, $9,800), Matthew Stafford (17.6, $10,000), Kyren Williams (15.2, $9,600) and Cam Skattebo (12.9, $9,400). The Rams are a 7-point favorite in a game totaled at 47.5, with implied team totals of 27.25 for the Rams and 20.25 for the Giants.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 20, 10:09 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jaxson Dart, NYG QB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Jaxson Dart holds 21.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 17.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 5.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Dart averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 32.8. He holds 79% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.0% as the captain and 58.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Matthew Stafford, LAR QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Matthew Stafford holds 20.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 17.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Stafford averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.9 and a ceiling of 33.0. He holds 78% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 20.7% as the captain and 57.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Kyren Williams, LAR RB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Kyren Williams holds 15.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,400 and the 15.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 15.2 carries and 2.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 15.2 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 29.3. He holds 64% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.3% as the captain and 48.4% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Giants vs Rams

Puka Nacua, LAR WR ($11,400 FLEX / $17,100 CPT)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 19.3 DraftKings points for an $11,400 FLEX salary ($17,100 at captain). The model gives him 8.9 targets on 25.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 19.3 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 40.4. He holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.0% as the captain and 0.0% in a FLEX spot.

Cam Skattebo, NYG RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Cam Skattebo carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.9 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). The model gives him 11.9 carries and 3.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Skattebo averaged 12.8 points with a simulated floor of 4.8 and a ceiling of 25.0. He holds 50% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.9% as the captain and 43.4% in a FLEX spot.

Davante Adams, LAR WR ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Davante Adams carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.2 DraftKings points for an $8,800 FLEX salary ($13,200 at captain). The model gives him 6.4 targets on 21.9 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Adams averaged 11.1 points with a simulated floor of 3.8 and a ceiling of 23.4. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.9% as the captain and 36.0% in a FLEX spot.

Malik Nabers, NYG WR ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Malik Nabers carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.7 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). The model gives him 6.9 targets on 22.5 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Nabers averaged 10.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.8 and a ceiling of 27.9. He holds 35% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.0% as the captain and 28.3% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Devin Singletary, NYG RB ($3,000 FLEX / $4,500 CPT)

Devin Singletary projects for 6.9 DraftKings points at a $3,000 FLEX salary, 2.31 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 5.8 carries and 1.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Singletary averaged 7.0 points with a simulated floor of 1.1 and a ceiling of 16.7. He holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.8% as the captain and 16.1% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Theo Johnson, NYG TE ($2,400 FLEX / $3,600 CPT)

Theo Johnson projects for 5.4 DraftKings points at a $2,400 FLEX salary, 2.24 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.2 targets on 16.9 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Johnson averaged 5.4 points with a simulated floor of 0.5 and a ceiling of 14.0. He holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.4% as the captain and 12.3% in a FLEX spot.
